note: On top of Chilhowee Mountain in two groups of loops: A and B beside 7-acre McKamy Lake (swim beach, no gas motors), C to F to the east. Electric is 30-amp in loops A and B, 50-amp in E and F. The way up is paved FR 77 (Oswald Dome Road), a narrow, winding 7.5-mile climb; the Forest Service warns not to follow GPS up unpaved Benton Springs Road, which it calls dangerous for RVs. Overflow and day-use areas stay open year-round. --Claude
summary: USFS Cherokee NF campground confirmed on recreation.gov + FS page: 59 sites (48 RV-bookable), $12 non-electric / $20 electric, 30/50-amp, dump, showers; season 04-14 to 11-14 per rec.gov (first week FCFS). Pin sits on FR 77 ~570 m from the sites. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PIN MOVE >250 m: stored 35.15551,-84.61028 is on FR 77 at the recreation-area turn; the rec.gov site centroid 35.1510,-84.6074 (beside the day-use parking between the A-B and C-F loop groups) is ~570 m SSE. Suggested target 35.1510,-84.6074.

ACCESS (not a drop): recreation.gov 'this facility requires driving 7 miles up to Chilhowee Campground on a narrow, winding road. Do not use the Benton Springs Access Road to the campground as this is an unpaved and dangerous road for RVs. Inexperienced RV drivers may have difficulties getting to and around the site.' No 4WD/high-clearance requirement and no 'not recommended for RVs' on the paved FR 77 route; kept.

SITE COUNT: rec.gov catalog 59 sites (stored 62). The FS page says 'more than 70 campsites' and its fee lines add to 78 (42 non-electric, 29 electric, 7 walk-in) - FS figures look older or include overflow; went with the catalog.

SEASON: FS page says 'usually open from early April to late October' and still lists 'Seasons of Use 4/14/2025 - 10/20/2025'; recreation.gov sold nights through 2026-11-14 and its 2027 rate seasons run 04-14 to 11-14. Wrote 04-14 to 11-14 from rec.gov.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. A-loop RV sites 01/02 (35.14884,-84.61312 / 35.14894,-84.61270) sit ~100-130 m west of the west tip of 7-acre McKamy Lake under canopy; tent-only 03/04 are closer but are not RV sites. No site within 50 m.
HOOKUPS: no water/sewer attribute on any rec.gov site (water hydrants in the loops); water/sewer left absent, not written false.
Phone 423-338-3300 and both websites confirmed. Horses not allowed (FS page).
